text:
Type: white and silver sphere pendant lamp
Use: decorative ambient light over a dining table or a sitting area; living room, dining room, bedroom
Style: contemporary, modern, Scandinavian
Materials: white plastic panels, silver metallic inner surfaces, white cord and ceiling cup, metal pull cord
Colors: white, silver, glints of cool chrome
Shape: sphere of interlocking puzzle-like panels that open or close with a pull cord, hangs on a long cord, sculptural, medium visual weight
Feel: playful, futuristic, sculptural, bright
Goes with: white walls, grey and black accents, glass and chrome; contemporary or modern living and dining rooms

product.name: IKEA PS 2014
product.description: Light bulb sold separately. IKEA recommends LED bulb E27 600 lumen globe clear. View more product information You can easily switch between a brighter general light and a softer mood light by just pulling the strings.
